sloka: पौरापवादः सुमहांस्तथा जनपदस्य च ।वर्तते मयि बीभत्सा सा मे मर्माणि कृन्तति ।। ७.४५.३ ॥
transliteration: paurāpavādaḥ sumahāṁstathā janapadasya ca ।vartate mayi bībhatsā sā me marmāṇi kṛntati ।। 7.45.3 ॥

translations.english: A very great and abhorrent scandal from both the citizens and the people of the country exists concerning me, and that talk cuts into my very vitals.
